# oxide_system_subnet_pools (Data Source)

Retrieve all configured subnet pools for the Oxide system.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oxide_system_subnet_pools" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `subnet_pools` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnet_pools))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--subnet_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnet_pools`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description for the subnet pool.
- `id` (String) Unique, immutable, system-controlled identifier of the subnet pool.
- `ip_version` (String) The IP version for this pool (v4 or v6).
- `name` (String) Name of the subnet pool.
- `time_created` (String) Timestamp of when this subnet pool was created.
- `time_modified` (String) Timestamp of when this subnet pool was last modified.
